## New files (`dotnet/src/Microsoft.Agents.AI/Harness/Todo/`)

- **`TodoItem.cs`** — public sealed class with `Id` (int), `Title` (string), `Description` (string?), `IsComplete` (bool, defaults false).

- **`TodoProvider.cs`** — public sealed `AIContextProvider` with a parameterless constructor. It stores state per-session via `ProviderSessionState<TodoState>` under the key `"TodoProvider"` using `AgentJsonUtilities.DefaultOptions`, and exposes:
  - `InvokingAsync` → `AIContext` with non-null `Instructions` and exactly 5 tools.
  - The 5 tools bound to the invocation's session: `AddTodos` (param `todos`), `CompleteTodos` (param `ids`, returns int count of matched items), `RemoveTodos` (param `ids`, returns int removed), `GetRemainingTodos` (returns incomplete items as a JSON array), `GetAllTodos` (returns all items).
  - Public `GetAllTodos(AgentSession?)` → `IReadOnlyList<TodoItem>` and `GetRemainingTodos(AgentSession?)` → `List<TodoItem>`.
